components.label: Sensors / clients
components.explanation: Sensors are implicit: they exist once their first reading arrives. Retries are safe because ingest is idempotent on (sensor_id, metric, ts).

components.label: Demo UI
components.explanation: One static page served by FastAPI. Picks sensors, metrics, statistic and range, then shows a results table and a simple per-metric bar comparison. No build step.

components.label: Ingest route
components.explanation: Validates a batch of 1 to 1000 readings (tz-aware timestamps, finite values, metric name pattern), writes it in one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, and returns 201 {inserted, duplicates} only after commit. Retries are no-ops.

components.label: Query route
components.explanation: Resolves the half-open range [start, end) (default last 24 h, 1 to 31 days) and runs one SQL GROUP BY sensor_id, metric with min/max/sum/avg. Unknown sensors or metrics and empty ranges simply return no rows. The same app also serves the static demo UI.

components.label: PostgreSQL 17
components.explanation: One narrow table readings(sensor_id, metric, ts, value) with PRIMARY KEY (sensor_id, metric, ts). The key gives idempotent ingest and serves range queries. Unpartitioned on purpose: partitioning and rollups are documented next steps.

components.label: Seed script
components.explanation: Bulk-loads N sensors x 30 days of sine-plus-noise data with COPY, for the demo and the data-volume perf sweep.

cards.title: Write path
items: Batch of 1 to 1000 readings, many metrics each
One INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING per request

cards.title: Read path
items: One SQL GROUP BY sensor_id, metric: min/max/sum/avg
Half-open range, 1 to 31 days, default last 24 h
No data or unknown ids: results: [] (never null)

cards.title: Known limits
items: Single Postgres node: no replica or failover
Ingest and query share one process pool; split if k6 shows contention
No broker, no auth, no rollups: see next steps
